svg.title: Frozen RGB risk on DTU photographs

cc:Work.dc:title: Frozen RGB risk on DTU photographs
cc:Work.dc:description: Four panels comparing four fixed methods on set1 and set6 using the recorded accepted-pixel and RGB-error counts.
